name: interocitor-monorepo
description: Umbrella monorepo for Interocitor packages, runtimes, examples, and future platform ports.

scripts.build:all: yarn build:int && yarn build:web && yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude @interocitor/core --exclude @interocitor/web -p run build
scripts.check:publint: publint run packages/core --strict --pack false && publint run packages/web --strict --pack false && publint run packages/react --strict --pack false && publint run packages/workers --strict --pack false && publint run packages/webdav --strict --pack false
scripts.check:types: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/workers/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check:knip: knip --workspace packages/core --workspace packages/web --workspace packages/react --workspace packages/workers --workspace packages/webdav --include files --no-progress --reporter compact
scripts.test:e2e:todo: yarn build:int && yarn build:web && yarn workspace todo-webdav-example check
scripts.test:e2e:cloudflare: yarn build:int && yarn build:web && playwright test -c examples/todo-cloudflare-do/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:cloudflare:run: yarn build:int && yarn build:web && RUN_CF_EXAMPLE_TESTS=1 playwright test -c examples/todo-cloudflare-do/playwright.config.ts
